questions.knowledge_point: Simplifying Expressions in Degrees Using the Sum and Difference Formulas
questions.worked_solution:
First, we recall the sum formula for cosine:

$$
\operatorname{cos}⁡(u+v)=\operatorname{cos}⁡u\operatorname{cos}⁡v-\operatorname{sin}⁡u\operatorname{sin}⁡v
$$

Applying the sum formula for cosine with $u=x$ and $v={90}^{∘}$, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{cos}⁡(x+{90}^{∘}) & =\operatorname{cos}⁡x\operatorname{cos}⁡{90}^{∘}-\operatorname{sin}⁡x\operatorname{sin}⁡{90}^{∘} \\  & =\operatorname{cos}⁡x\cdot 0-\operatorname{sin}⁡x\cdot 1 \\  & =-\operatorname{sin}⁡x.\end{aligned}
$$

questions.knowledge_point: Simplifying Expressions in Degrees Using the Sum and Difference Formulas
questions.worked_solution:
First, we recall the difference formula for cosine:

$$
\operatorname{cos}⁡(u-v)=\operatorname{cos}⁡u\operatorname{cos}⁡v+\operatorname{sin}⁡u\operatorname{sin}⁡v
$$

Applying the difference formula for cosine with $u=x$ and $v={150}^{∘},$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{cos}⁡(x-{150}^{∘}) & =\operatorname{cos}⁡x\operatorname{cos}⁡{150}^{∘}+\operatorname{sin}⁡x\operatorname{sin}⁡{150}^{∘} \\  & =\operatorname{cos}⁡x\cdot (-\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2})+\operatorname{sin}⁡x\cdot \frac{1}{2} \\  & =-\frac{\sqrt{3}\operatorname{cos}⁡x}{2}+\frac{\operatorname{sin}⁡x}{2} \\  & =\frac{\operatorname{sin}⁡x-\sqrt{3}\operatorname{cos}⁡x}{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

questions.knowledge_point: Simplifying Expressions in Radians Using the Sum and Difference Formulas
questions.worked_solution:
First, we recall the difference formula for cosine:

$$
\operatorname{cos}⁡(u-v)=\operatorname{cos}⁡u\operatorname{cos}⁡v+\operatorname{sin}⁡u\operatorname{sin}⁡v
$$

Applying the difference formula for cosine with $u=x$ and $v=\frac{\pi }{2},$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{cos}⁡(x-\frac{\pi }{2}) & =\operatorname{cos}⁡x\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{\pi }{2})+\operatorname{sin}⁡x\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{\pi }{2}) \\  & =\operatorname{cos}⁡x\cdot 0+\operatorname{sin}⁡x\cdot 1 \\  & =\operatorname{sin}⁡x.\end{aligned}
$$
